description:
Hey! I’m an 11th grader from Noida playing online via the Delhi Hub. I started The Stardust Weavers to build a fairytale-style 2D Scratch game starring Clumsynaut! We’ll turn NASA's prompts into a cute arcade quest where you collect elements to survive.

Let's split the 48-hour work! Looking for:
⭐ Scratch Coders: To help map out scripts & logic.
📜 Researchers/Writers: To find space facts & write story dialogue.
🎨 Artists/Designers: To source cute 2D sprites & music.
summary:
Clumsynaut: Journey Through the Universe

"Clumsynaut: Journey Through the Universe" is an interactive, story-driven space exploration game that takes players on a scientific adventure beyond Earth.

Accompanied by Clumsynaut, players travel across the universe, exploring destinations including Saturn, Mars, Earth's Moon, the Sun, Wolf–Rayet stars and black holes.
At each destination, players can discover fascinating astronomical objects, use an onboard scanner to uncover scientific information and explore dedicated Adventure Data Pages. These pages introduce discoveries through an interactive swipe experience, allowing players to explore space-related facts at their own pace.
Combining spacecraft journeys, visual storytelling, scanning interactions and educational content, the game transforms astronomy into an engaging exploration experience.

Our goal is to spark curiosity about the universe, introduce players to fascinating astronomical phenomena and make learning about space feel like an adventure.
Explore, Discover, Learn, Beyond the Stars.
details:
Clumsynaut: Journey Through the Universe✨

Our project, Clumsynaut: Journey Through the Universe, is a space exploration game where players join an astronaut named Clumsynaut on a journey through different parts of space. The journey includes Saturn, Mars, Earth's Moon, the Sun, a Wolf–Rayet star and a black hole.

Players can control a spacecraft, use a scanner to discover interesting facts about different space objects and save their discoveries in the Adventure Data Pages.

We made this game using Scratch. We used pictures from ChatGPT, Gemini and NASA, and collected information from NASA websites with the help of ChatGPT.

The main aim of our project is to make learning about space more interesting and fun. Instead of just reading facts, players get to explore different celestial objects as part of a journey. We hope this project encourages people to become more curious about astronomy and the universe.

What makes our project special is the way we have combined a fictional space adventure with real scientific information. While making the game, we focused on keeping it educational, interesting, easy to explore and visually engaging.

Explore. Discover. Learn. Beyond the Stars.
